subject: bia
title: BIA.------AFI.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 82 (WAM-24). BIA (bi-aitional) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; AFI-DY is the partner. From the subject: TH-CONT-DY (thrust continuance dynamics). From AFI-DY: SOC-RT (social reality) and PHY-U-C (physical universe context). From TH-CONT-DY: AFI-DY. From SOC-RT: VT-AF-ATT (vibrational affinity and/or attitude). From PHY-U-C: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From VT-AF-ATT: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics).
